title: Hugo site one-time importer
lead: Import recipes from a Hugo site's content directory into the recipe repo once (ADR 0011).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** ongoing sync; publishing back to the Hugo site (Later).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Existing recipes seed the rotation. The importer is also the first plugin, and it defines the importer interface (ADR 0005).

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Source: read from a local clone path the owner provides, or fetch from GitHub over HTTPS (public)? Recommend a local path or a public raw fetch, with no credentials either way.
2. Which content directory, and should any recipes be skipped (duplicates, drafts)?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Define an `Importer` protocol: `discover() -> list[SourceRecipe]`, `to_doc(src) -> RecipeDoc`.
2. Hugo importer: read `*.md`, parse, normalize headings, keep the body.
3. Write files into the recipe repo; one commit, then push.
4. CLI subcommand plus dry-run that prints a plan.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Importer tests pass.
- A dry run against the owner's Hugo site lists the expected recipes; the real run creates them in the recipe repo, with the owner's approval for the push.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks (this repo). The recipe-repo push happens only after the owner approves it.
